title: Steamed Chestnut Salad
description: A refreshing Thai-inspired salad featuring steamed chestnuts and crunchy salad greens, finished with sweet dates.

ingredients.name: Peeled and chopped Dates
ingredients.notes: Fresh or dried dates work well

instructions: Chop the steamed chestnuts into bite-sized pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the salad greens and chopped dates.
In a small bowl, whisk together the water and chopped green onions.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Top the salad with the chopped chestnuts.
